svg.title: Wind turbine technician — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as wind turbine technician, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: Three long separated wind-turbine blades surround a small hub above a mast with one access rung. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
